LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.4: Reading Aloud
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud, part of Reading in Grade 7 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: Why is reading fluency important in effective communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read aloud a short text highlighting holidays and festivities (圣诞节、情人节、 新年、劳 动节、独立日、自治日(zìzhì rì)as their peers mark any unfamiliar words,

2. work jointly to research the meanings of the words and share their findings,

3. read short poems related to important dates at the appropriate pace,

4. work with peers to read and count numbers aloud,

5. rearrange sentences related to birth dates and take turns reading them aloud in the correct sequence,

6. use flashcards to respond to the prompts on their dates of birth for critique by peers,

7. record themselves reading texts related to important dates and identify

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read aloud a short text highlighting holidays and festivities (圣诞节、情人节、 新年、劳 动节、独立日、自治日(zìzhì rì)as their peers mark any unfamiliar words,
2. work jointly to research the meanings of the words and share their findings,
3. read short poems related to important dates at the appropriate pace,
4. work with peers to read and count numbers aloud,
5. rearrange sentences related to birth dates and take turns reading them aloud in the correct sequence,
6. use flashcards to respond to the prompts on their dates of birth for critique by peers,
7. record themselves reading texts related to important dates and identify

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: digital citizenship is promoted when the learner discusses how to be safe and responsible users of

technology when undertaking various reading tasks.

• Learning to Learn: the learner reflects on their own work as they record their reading to identify where they need help.

Values:
Patriotism: the learner develops an awareness of their own culture when they explore different important days in texts.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety and Security: this is enhanced as the learner becomes aware of how to observe safety precautions and practices when

using digital technology during the discussion.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the concept of important national days to Social Studies.
